EmailTemplate.subject: ITA - FAQ Accrual Plan Changes - TES
EmailTemplate.textOnly:
Hello {!Contact.FirstName}
We understand that you are interested in making changes to your accrual plan setup in your system. For us to determine the extent of the changes, we have a few items we’d appreciate your answers to:
Please attach a written version of your policy from your handbook, so our technicians can verify accurate setup.
Is this a change to an existing policy, or a new policy setup?
If it is a change, which policy are we adjusting?
If it is a new setup, what do you want it to be called?
What is the effective date of the change?
Will all the employees in your system be impacted by this change, or will it only be a certain group/groups?
If it is a certain group/groups, which group/groups of employees will be impacted?
Will you need a new pay type in your system for this change?
Thank you for your assistance in answering these questions. Once we receive the answers, our team will determine the next steps and be in touch as soon as they’re able.
Thank you,
Technical Support Team
8401 Greenway Blvd. Suite 1100 | Middleton, WI 53562 OFFICE: 800-314-8223 | FAX: 262-364-3800
